content: अघ {%a.%} [अघ्-कर्तरि अच्] .²1 Bad, sinful, evil, wicked; अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति <ls>Bg. 3. 16</ls>. .{@-घम्@} [अघ् भावे अच्] .²1 Sin; अघं स केवलं भुङ्क्ते यः पचत्यात्मकारणात् <ls>Ms. 3. 118</ls>; <ls>Bg. 3. 13</ls>; अघौघविध्वंसविधौ पटीयसीः <ls>Śi. 1. 18</ls>, हरत्यघं सम्प्रति हेतुरेष्यतः <ls n="Śi. 1.">26</ls>; ˚मर्षण <ab>&c.</ab>; misdeed, fault, crime; श्रेयान् द्विजातिरिव हन्तुमघानि दक्षम् <ls>Śi. 4. 37</ls> sins and griefs also. .²2 An evil, mishap, misfortune, accident, injury, harm; न वधूष्वघानि विमृशन्ति धियः <ls>Ki. 6. 45</ls> do not think of doing harm or evil; क्रियादघानां मघवा विघातम् <ls n="Ki.">3. 52</ls>; अघोपघातं मघवा विभूत्यै <ls n="Ki.">11. 80</ls>; प्रजानां तमघावहम् <ls>R. 15. 51</ls>, <ls n="R.">19. 52</ls>; see अनघ. .²3 Impurity (अशौचम्); अनुरुन्ध्यादघं त्र्यहम् <ls>Ms. 5. 63</ls>; न वर्धयेदघाहानि <ls n="Ms. 5.">84</ls>. न राज्ञामघदोषोऽस्ति <ls n="Ms. 5.">93</ls>; .²4 Pain, suffering, grief, distress; उपप्लुतमघौघेन नात्मानमवबुद्धयसे <ls>Rām. 2. 7. 14</ls>; <ls>Mb. 3. 237. 19</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 14. 20</ls>. दयालुमनघस्पृष्टम् <ls>R. 10. 19</ls> not subject to grief. .²5 Passion. <ab>cf.</ab> अंहोदुःखव्यसनेष्वघम् <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-घः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, brother of Baka and Pūtanā and commander-in-chief of Kaṃsa. [Being sent by Kaṃsa to Gokula to kill Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma he assumed the form of a huge serpent 4 yojanas long, and spread himself on the way of the cowherds, keeping his horrid mouth open. The cowherds mistook it for a mountain cavern and entered it, cows and all. But Kṛṣṇa saw it, and having entered the mouth so stretched himself that he tore it to pieces and rescued his companions.] .{@-घा@} The Goddess of sin; (<ab>pl.</ab>) the constellation usually called Maghā.
